podcast.body: The cinematic music video for "Thriller," directed by John Landis and modeled after "An American Werewolf in London," premiered on MTV on December 2, 1983, giving the channel its highest ratings ever. The song itself was issued as a single in January 1984, a full 14 months after the album's release, and became the LP's record seventh top 10 single, peaking at number four on the Hot 100 in March 1984. "Michael Jackson's cinematic thriller video directed by John Landis and modeled after his horror film and American Werewolf in London premiered on MTV. Jackson's clip gave the fledgling video channel which had launched just two years earlier its highest ratings ever."
